Kerala High Court dismisses election petition against KC Venugopal

The Kerala High Court has rejected an election petition filed by AM Ariff of the CPI(M) challenging the victory of Congress MP KC Venugopal in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections. The court's decision means Venugopal's win will stand. The petition was based on allegations related to the election process.
